title: heightmap_meta.json
description: data/worlds/<id>/heightmap_meta.json, describing heightmap.raw (envgen common.write_heightmap_raw). heightmap.raw = resolution x resolution uint16 little-endian, row-major, row 0 = south edge (min z), col 0 = west edge (min x). world_y = min_height_m + value/65535 * height_range_m. Unity terrain: size = (size_m[0], height_range_m, size_m[1]), position = (origin[0], min_height_m, origin[1]). File size == resolution^2 * 2 bytes is checked by validate.py.

size_m.description: [x, z] extent covered, metres (matches world.json size_m).
